messages:
Alex M.: Morning — quick async check for the Sunburst pilot (what I did / blockers / today)
Alex M.: Done yesterday: final demo run, updated SOW and uploaded comments to the doc. Sent follow-up to champion.
Alex M.: Blocker: partner wants BYOK/HSM details before signing. Need a security blurb and timeline.
Alex M.: Today: follow up on BYOK, confirm Dedicated sizing, open PR to update demo dashboard configs.
Dana S.: +1 on HSM ask. @SecBot can you confirm current BYOK support and any immediate workarounds?
SecBot: SecBot: Current: customer-managed KMS with envelope keys is supported in Hosted for some flows. Full HSM-backed BYOK (cert + keywrap) is planned in Private/Dedicated roadmap; tentative GA Q2 2026. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/kms
Priya K.: Heads-up — legal left comments on retention clause in the SOW (linked in doc). I flagged a proposed phrasing.
Mike R.: PR ping: @Eng Platform can someone review https://github.com/redwood/sales-demos/pull/123 ? It's a small config tweak to expose demo metrics.
Oliver G.: Customer expects 300ms p50 for typical calls. They said 5k–8k tokens workload for embeddings + chat. Champion mentioned Dedicated SLA preference.
Alex M.: @Eng Runtime any concerns hitting ~300ms p50 on Dedicated with that token profile?
Eng Runtime: Eng Runtime: likely okay for short context windows on Ampere-class GPUs. With long horizons (8k tokens) batching will affect p50 — recommend session-affinity + prefix caching and quantify in benchmark.
Mike R.: Noted. We'll include benchmark numbers in the proposal.
Priya K.: Security ask also: 3-year audit log retention and KMS key rotation policy documented. Legal wants explicit wording.
Dana S.: Action list:
- @SecBot confirm BYOK workaround + timeline (Priya -> incorporate wording)
- @Eng Runtime provide quick perf estimate and a short benchmark note (Mike to include)
- Alex to set a call with partner after we have answers
Alex M.: I'll schedule a call for 2025-10-28 09:00 PT (proposed) — posting slot now, will update CRM.
SecBot: SecBot: Quick workaround: offer Dedicated pilot with customer-managed KMS + standard audit hooks today. HSM cert path requires Private deployment enrollment.
Mike R.: CR reminder: tagging @Dana S. for legal signoff text. Once we have the BYOK note I'll merge the PR and push demo.
Priya K.: Blocked only on final legal wording. Otherwise SOW ready pending BYOK confirmation.
Oliver G.: If timeline slips, sales ops suggests a time-limited Dedicated pilot with narrower SLA to move momentum.
Alex M.: Good idea — I'll add that alternative to the proposal. CRM entry: https://crm.example.com/cases/SUNBURST-12 (added notes).
Dana S.: :thumbsup:
Mike R.: Will merge PR after review. @Eng Platform please ping when demo env has new config deployed.
Alex M.: Final: next steps + owners in CRM. Thanks all — I'll follow up in the call and update this thread after the meeting.
